alignments.note: Anarthrous adjective and noun with no supplied determiner, so the dative's case preposition 'with' stays with the noun under rules 21 and 23.
Greek anarthrous, so the supplied indefinite is a rule 7 helper on the noun and the case preposition rides with it under rule 21.
One adjective rendered by preposition plus noun; rule 17 heads on the meaning-bearing 'blemish'.

The ASV resumes the sentence with a supplied 'even the blood'; the genitive Christou already has its own 'of Christ' and haimati its own 'with ... blood', so no source token licenses this repetition. Alternatively it could be read as a discontinuous second realization of haimati under rule 15.
